subject: general
question: Where is INS Sardar Patel Naval Base located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Porbandar.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **INS Sardar Patel** is a** Forward Operating Base (FOB)** of the** Indian Navy in Porbandar, Gujarat.**
 
• It is the** Headquarters **of the** Naval Officer-in-Charge (Gujarat, Diu & Daman).**
 
• It provides logistic support to the Indian Navy units deployed in the Northern Arabian Sea.
 
• It is the **second naval base** in Gujarat after INS Dwarka, which is near Okha.
 
• The name Sardar Patel has been chosen to signify the role of India’s Iron Man Vallabhai Patel. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The base was commissioned on **9 May 2015** by** Anandiben Patel**, the Chief Minister of Gujarat.
 
• **Cmde BR Prakash, VSM** who is the **Naval Officer-in-Charge i**s the first Commanding Officer of INS Sardar Patel.
 
• The commissioning ceremony was attended by
 
 
• Admiral RK Dhowan, Chief of the Naval Staff, Vice Admiral SPS Cheema
 
• Flag Officer Commanding–in–Chief, Western Naval Command, senior naval officers.
 
 
 
• The commissioning of INS Sardar Patel at Porbandar enables the Navy to augment its infrastructure.
 
• It will improve coordination and synergy with other maritime agencies.
